_what: Feature 449 T149's old-to-new map of the modals' ids and fingerprints (the round arbiter's ask:449-phase4-slices Q5: 'the commit records an old-to-new map that carries open rounds and rulings'). Every modal id and fingerprint whose value the move changed, old -> new. It is empty: feature 319 had already moved each kind's modal text out of its class docstring into one Markdown file per kind (l7r/diagram/interactive/assets/modals/<hamlet|sheet>/<slug of its key>.md), byte for byte; the files stay where they are, beside the Python registry that still reads them and the Rust registry (rust/gate/crates/registry/src/kinds.rs) that now enumerates them for modals.rs; a modal's uid is its registry and slug and no fingerprint reads where its file lives, so no id or fingerprint moved and no open round, ruling or answer needs carrying.
method: every modal's uid, class, key, file and three fingerprints (form, research, depiction) at HEAD 646ce17de, through HEAD's l7r-gate owed-door (mo.modals_now, mo.fingerprints, mo.depiction_fingerprint), against the port's `l7r-gate record modal-owed --ids`; compared byte for byte on the real record and on three changed records (a page's findings moved, a modal's prose rewritten, a question renumbered) by the differential's 'modal ids' cases
